F-15 Eagle exterior model
Source https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/f-15-eagle-fighter-jet-e1d11142
Author Innerscene. License CC0. Downloaded 2026-11-09.
The author describes this as an original F-15 style model. It is not an official manufacturer model.
The game uses an approximate independent flight configuration and its existing fighter cockpit.
GLTFLoader and BufferGeometryUtils are from Three.js r160, MIT license, covered by ../THREE-LICENSE.txt.

Airbus A220-300 and A380-800, Boeing 777-300ER, Cessna 172P, Diamond DA42
Source https://github.com/stagworksde/skytrails-aircraft-models/releases/tag/v0.1.0
FlightGear contributors and Skytrails. GPL-2.0-only. The original authors
and conversion notices are included in each unmodified GLB and in the source archive.
Corresponding source: skytrails-source.zip. License: SKYTRAILS-COPYING.txt.
The game positions these low-poly traffic exteriors at runtime and uses its
own cockpit and landing gear. The C172P exterior represents the SB-172 family.
